nodes.label: Pricing calculator (/pricing)
nodes.rationale: Three tabs with inverted semantics: verification is a COST calculator, payments/BC is an EARNINGS calculator (commissions are income to the partner), connected banking is a cost calculator. Money math runs in integer paise to avoid float drift.

nodes.label: PricingTabs forceMount (SEO-safe tabs)
nodes.rationale: All three panels stay in the prerendered HTML so every product's rates are crawlable from one URL; nothing unmounts so calculator state survives tab switches, and display:none also hides inactive tabs' fixed mobile bars.

nodes.label: Offline Excel calculator (/eps-pricing-calculator.xlsx)
nodes.rationale: Worksheets are created up-front so tab order is independent of build order (the Payments Rate Card is built first to hand over its DMT VLOOKUP range). Sheets are protected without a password — preventing accidental edits, not access control. exceljs stays out of the client bundle via ssrLoadModule + createRequire.

nodes.label: Pricing URL param scheme (tab/sel/apis/gst/pay/cb)
nodes.rationale: Every writer uses the functional setSearchParams updater and touches only its own keys, so UTM/tracking params and the other calculators' state always survive; unknown ids are dropped and garbage params never crash the page.

nodes.label: Lead attribution (tracking params, calculator context, SalesIQ identity)
nodes.rationale: Zoho SalesIQ records page URLs, so stored tracking params are re-appended after every internal navigation — attribution survives any link click without a per-link wrapper. Chat identity lives in a module store because the widget lazy-loads and rarely exists when /me resolves.

nodes.label: generatePricingJsonLd (OfferCatalogs + FAQPage)
nodes.rationale: No Offers are emitted for DMT/AePS/BBPS commissions — they are income to the buyer, so Offer semantics would be misleading in rich results; they are covered by FAQPage entries instead.
